conditions.shared: Existing archived baseline: up to eight questions share a schema and attention sequence.
conditions.isolated-native: One binary question per attention sequence. Preserve its original task name, instruction, label descriptions, world text and prefix; remove other questions. Replay exact original candidate groups and slot indices.
conditions.isolated-question-in-state: One binary question per sequence, with complete Question: instruction before the world as in the OpenDecision adapter. Use answer as the schema task name and no schema instruction. This layout condition includes the task-name change.

selection: No prompt selection. Freeze both controls before their predictions are observed. Requested after interim OpenDecision scores on 16 programs.
probability_evaluation: Freeze all model assessments obtained by replaying the baseline request groups, then run the unchanged hard-mode engine. Distinguish replayed model requests from the engine's subsequent lookup requests.
